## Problem and result

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link an issue only if useful.

## Verification

List commands or hosted checks actually run, their outcomes, and unverified work.
Include observable UI/guest evidence when those capabilities change.

## Risks and scope

Record compatibility, preservation or release limits that matter to reviewers.

For a `dev` to `main` promotion, include source release notes and the explicit owner
instruction. OS image/package publishing and installation require separate evidence.
